sloka: तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसन्निभानि प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि।पेतुः शिरांसीन्द्ररिपोर्धरण्यां ज्योतींषि मुक्तानि यथा ऽर्कमार्गात् ।। ६.७०.४८ ।।
transliteration: tānyāyatākṣāṇyagasannibhāni pradīptavaiśvānaralocanāni।petuḥ śirāṁsīndraripordharaṇyāṁ jyotīṁṣi muktāni yathā 'rkamārgāt ।। 6.70.48 ।।

translations.english: The heads of Trisira, an enemy of Indra, resembling mountains with incongruous eyes glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, fell into wilderness like stars fallen from the path of Sun.
